learning_outcomes.text: Acquire theoretical and practical elements regarding the basic processes of heat and thermochemical treatments.
Determine the technological parameters (temperature, heating rate and duration, holding duration, and cooling rate and duration) of a heat or thermochemical treatment.

syllabus_topics: Subject and importance of heat and thermochemical treatments
Technological parameters of heat treatment operations and their determination method
Determination of heating duration using simplified calculation relations
Determination of heating duration by the criterion method
Determination of cooling duration by the criterion method
Modern methods of analysis of temperature fields and stress distribution during heating and cooling of heat-treated parts
Annealing for stress relief of ferrous alloy products
Selection of heating temperature and holding duration
Determination of technological parameters of tempering
Thermochemical treatments for anticorrosion protection by superficial oxidation
Heat treatments applied to non-ferrous metals and alloys
Specific heat treatment technologies applied to cutting tools
Materials used in cutting tool construction
Heat treatments applied to drills and reamers
Heat treatments applied to threading tools
Heat treatment of saw blades and discs
Heat treatments applied to tools for machining materials without chip removal
Heat treatment of cold working tools
Heat treatments applied to hot plastic deformation tools
Specific heat and thermochemical treatment technologies applied to different types of parts in machine construction
Heat treatments applied to straight shafts
Heat treatments applied to gear wheels
Influence of alloying elements on the hardenability of steels
Determination of technological parameters for heat treatment regimes
Heat treatments applied to tools made of high alloy steels
Influence of technological parameters on the structure and characteristics of the carburized layer in gaseous medium
Heat treatments applied to grey cast irons
Heat treatments applied to non-ferrous alloys
Study of proposed heat treatments for product application

assessment_methods.method: Tests at the end of specific laboratory activity
